en.description: Turn seller-supplied ingredient and allergen facts into one allergen explanation card per SKU. This allergen label card studio lays out the seller-supplied allergens and ingredients as an allergen listing still. Use it for food allergen notices, SKU allergen cards, and product-page ingredient explanation graphics.
